component.name: Capsule
component.summary: Run portable applications in isolated, removable environments

description.p: Capsule imports a portable Windows or Linux application into a single removable capsule file and launches it through a private Gamescope, Xwayland and Bubblewrap environment.
Network, audio, clipboard and other permissions are controlled outside the capsule. Capsule is experimental and is not a malware-analysis tool.
